editorial.name: Harness Open Source
editorial.descriptionZh: gitness.com 现在跳到 Harness 的开源交付平台页。把代码仓库、Gitspaces 云开发环境、CI/CD 流水线和制品仓库打包成一套可以自托管的方案。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看它怎么把 Gitspaces 和制品仓库排进同一页
editorial.noteZh: 首屏黑底，衬线标题 The end-to-end open source software delivery platform，下一段写 Configure hosted development environments, manage code repositories, build, test, deploy, and manage artifacts — all from a centralized place.，按钮是 Get started 与 Read the announcement blog，右侧一张深色赛道状渲染图。往下每块用大写小标引导：REPOSITORIES（Familiar Git experience… Commit. Branch. Merge.）、CLOUD DEVELOPMENT ENVIRONMENTS（Gitspaces™ 的 Pre-configured 与 Consistent 两条）、PIPELINES（Ship Code Fast. Automate Everything. 与 Build. Test. Deploy.）、ARTIFACT REGISTRY（Centralize Your Artifacts）；页面顶上仍留着 Harness 主站的 Platform、Why Harness、Pricing、Customers 导航。

reasons.statement: gitness.com 实测跳到 harness.io/open-source，来源仍是 saaslandingpage.com；页面是 Harness 开源交付平台的产品介绍，按产品官网而非组件库归类。
